en.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「你进去见法老，对他说：『耶和华—希伯来人的 神这样说：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「你進去見法老，對他說：『耶和華－希伯來人的上帝這樣說：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。

en.text: For if you refuse to let them go, and hold them still,

zhSimplified.text: 你若不肯容他们去，仍旧强留他们，

zhTraditional.text: 你若不肯容他們去，仍舊強留他們，

en.text: behold, the LORD’s hand is on your livestock which are in the field, on the horses, on the donkeys, on the camels, on the herds, and on the flocks with a very grievous pestilence.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的手加在你田间的牲畜上，就是在马、驴、骆驼、牛群、羊群上，必有重重的瘟疫。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的手加在你田間的牲畜上，就是在馬、驢、駱駝、牛群、羊群上，必有重重的瘟疫。

en.text: The LORD will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and the livestock of Egypt; and nothing shall die of all that belongs to the children of Israel.”’”

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华要分别以色列的牲畜和埃及的牲畜，凡属以色列人的，一样都不死。』」

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華要分別以色列的牲畜和埃及的牲畜，凡屬以色列人的，一樣都不死。』」

en.text: The LORD appointed a set time, saying, “Tomorrow the LORD shall do this thing in the land.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华就定了时候，说：「明天耶和华必在此地行这事。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華就定了時候，說：「明天耶和華必在此地行這事。」

en.text: The LORD did that thing on the next day; and all the livestock of Egypt died, but of the livestock of the children of Israel, not one died.

zhSimplified.text: 第二天，耶和华就行这事。埃及的牲畜几乎都死了，只是以色列人的牲畜，一个都没有死。

zhTraditional.text: 第二天，耶和華就行這事。埃及的牲畜幾乎都死了，只是以色列人的牲畜，一個都沒有死。

en.text: Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not so much as one of the livestock of the Israelites dead. But the heart of Pharaoh was stubborn, and he didn’t let the people go.

zhSimplified.text: 法老打发人去看，谁知以色列人的牲畜连一个都没有死。法老的心却是固执，不容百姓去。

zhTraditional.text: 法老打發人去看，誰知以色列人的牲畜連一個都沒有死。法老的心卻是固執，不容百姓去。

en.text: The LORD said to Moses and to Aaron, “Take handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the sky in the sight of Pharaoh.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华吩咐摩西、亚伦说：「你们取几捧炉灰，摩西要在法老面前向天扬起来。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華吩咐摩西、亞倫說：「你們取幾捧爐灰，摩西要在法老面前向天揚起來。

en.text: It shall become small dust over all the land of Egypt, and shall be boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal, throughout all the land of Egypt.”

zhSimplified.text: 这灰要在埃及全地变作尘土，在人身上和牲畜身上成了起泡的疮。」

zhTraditional.text: 這灰要在埃及全地變作塵土，在人身上和牲畜身上成了起泡的瘡。」

en.text: They took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward the sky; and it became boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西、亚伦取了炉灰，站在法老面前。摩西向天扬起来，就在人身上和牲畜身上成了起泡的疮。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西、亞倫取了爐灰，站在法老面前。摩西向天揚起來，就在人身上和牲畜身上成了起泡的瘡。

en.text: The magicians couldn’t stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boils were on the magicians and on all the Egyptians.

zhSimplified.text: 行法术的在摩西面前站立不住，因为在他们身上和一切埃及人身上都有这疮。

zhTraditional.text: 行法術的在摩西面前站立不住，因為在他們身上和一切埃及人身上都有這瘡。

en.text: The LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken to Moses.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华使法老的心刚硬，不听他们，正如耶和华对摩西所说的。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華使法老的心剛硬，不聽他們，正如耶和華對摩西所說的。

en.text: The LORD said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对摩西说：「你清早起来，站在法老面前，对他说：『耶和华—希伯来人的 神这样说：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對摩西說：「你清早起來，站在法老面前，對他說：『耶和華－希伯來人的上帝這樣說：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。

en.text: For this time I will send all my plagues against your heart, against your officials, and against your people; that you may know that there is no one like me in all the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 因为这一次我要叫一切的灾殃临到你和你臣仆并你百姓的身上，叫你知道在普天下没有像我的。

zhTraditional.text: 因為這一次我要叫一切的災殃臨到你和你臣僕並你百姓的身上，叫你知道在普天下沒有像我的。

en.text: For now I would have stretched out my hand, and struck you and your people with pestilence, and you would have been cut off from the earth;

zhSimplified.text: 我若伸手用瘟疫攻击你和你的百姓，你早就从地上除灭了。

zhTraditional.text: 我若伸手用瘟疫攻擊你和你的百姓，你早就從地上除滅了。

en.text: but indeed for this cause I have made you stand: to show you my power, and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth,

zhSimplified.text: 其实，我叫你存立，是特要向你显我的大能，并要使我的名传遍天下。

zhTraditional.text: 其實，我叫你存立，是特要向你顯我的大能，並要使我的名傳遍天下。

en.text: because you still exalt yourself against my people, that you won’t let them go.

zhSimplified.text: 你还向我的百姓自高，不容他们去吗？

zhTraditional.text: 你還向我的百姓自高，不容他們去嗎？

en.text: Behold, tomorrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as has not been in Egypt since the day it was founded even until now.

zhSimplified.text: 到明天约在这时候，我必叫重大的冰雹降下，自从埃及开国以来，没有这样的冰雹。

zhTraditional.text: 到明天約在這時候，我必叫重大的冰雹降下，自從埃及開國以來，沒有這樣的冰雹。

en.text: Now therefore command that all of your livestock and all that you have in the field be brought into shelter. The hail will come down on every man and animal that is found in the field, and isn’t brought home, and they will die.”’”

zhSimplified.text: 现在你要打发人把你的牲畜和你田间一切所有的催进来；凡在田间不收回家的，无论是人是牲畜，冰雹必降在他们身上，他们就必死。』」

zhTraditional.text: 現在你要打發人把你的牲畜和你田間一切所有的催進來；凡在田間不收回家的，無論是人是牲畜，冰雹必降在他們身上，他們就必死。』」

en.text: Those who feared the LORD’s word among the servants of Pharaoh made their servants and their livestock flee into the houses.

zhSimplified.text: 法老的臣仆中，惧怕耶和华这话的，便叫他的奴仆和牲畜跑进家来。

zhTraditional.text: 法老的臣僕中，懼怕耶和華這話的，便叫他的奴僕和牲畜跑進家來。

en.text: Whoever didn’t respect the LORD’s word left his servants and his livestock in the field.

zhSimplified.text: 但那不把耶和华这话放在心上的，就将他的奴仆和牲畜留在田里。

zhTraditional.text: 但那不把耶和華這話放在心上的，就將他的奴僕和牲畜留在田裏。

en.text: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, on man, and on animal, and on every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对摩西说：「你向天伸杖，使埃及遍地的人身上和牲畜身上，并田间各样菜蔬上，都有冰雹。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對摩西說：「你向天伸杖，使埃及遍地的人身上和牲畜身上，並田間各樣菜蔬上，都有冰雹。」

en.text: Moses stretched out his rod toward the heavens, and the LORD sent thunder and hail; and lightning flashed down to the earth. The LORD rained hail on the land of Egypt.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西向天伸杖，耶和华就打雷下雹，有火闪到地上；耶和华下雹在埃及地上。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西向天伸杖，耶和華就打雷下雹，有火閃到地上；耶和華下雹在埃及地上。

en.text: So there was very severe hail, and lightning mixed with the hail, such as had not been in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，雹与火搀杂，甚是厉害，自从埃及成国以来，遍地没有这样的。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，雹與火攙雜，甚是厲害，自從埃及成國以來，遍地沒有這樣的。

en.text: The hail struck throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and animal; and the hail struck every herb of the field, and broke every tree of the field.

zhSimplified.text: 在埃及遍地，雹击打了田间所有的人和牲畜，并一切的菜蔬，又打坏田间一切的树木。

zhTraditional.text: 在埃及遍地，雹擊打了田間所有的人和牲畜，並一切的菜蔬，又打壞田間一切的樹木。

en.text: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, there was no hail.

zhSimplified.text: 惟独以色列人所住的歌珊地没有冰雹。

zhTraditional.text: 惟獨以色列人所住的歌珊地沒有冰雹。

en.text: Pharaoh sent and called for Moses and Aaron, and said to them, “I have sinned this time. The LORD is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.

zhSimplified.text: 法老打发人召摩西、亚伦来，对他们说：「这一次我犯了罪了。耶和华是公义的；我和我的百姓是邪恶的。

zhTraditional.text: 法老打發人召摩西、亞倫來，對他們說：「這一次我犯了罪了。耶和華是公義的；我和我的百姓是邪惡的。

en.text: Pray to the LORD; for there has been enough of mighty thunderings and hail. I will let you go, and you shall stay no longer.”

zhSimplified.text: 这雷轰和冰雹已经够了。请你们求耶和华，我就容你们去，不再留住你们。」

zhTraditional.text: 這雷轟和冰雹已經夠了。請你們求耶和華，我就容你們去，不再留住你們。」

en.text: Moses said to him, “As soon as I have gone out of the city, I will spread out my hands to the LORD. The thunders shall cease, and there will not be any more hail; that you may know that the earth is the LORD’s.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西对他说：「我一出城，就要向耶和华举手祷告；雷必止住，也不再有冰雹，叫你知道全地都是属耶和华的。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西對他說：「我一出城，就要向耶和華舉手禱告；雷必止住，也不再有冰雹，叫你知道全地都是屬耶和華的。

en.text: But as for you and your servants, I know that you don’t yet fear the LORD God.”

zhSimplified.text: 至于你和你的臣仆，我知道你们还是不惧怕耶和华 神。」（

zhTraditional.text: 至於你和你的臣僕，我知道你們還是不懼怕耶和華上帝。」（

en.text: The flax and the barley were struck, for the barley had ripened and the flax was blooming.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，麻和大麦被雹击打；因为大麦已经吐穗，麻也开了花。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，麻和大麥被雹擊打；因為大麥已經吐穗，麻也開了花。

en.text: But the wheat and the spelt were not struck, for they had not grown up.

zhSimplified.text: 只是小麦和粗麦没有被击打，因为还没有长成。）

zhTraditional.text: 只是小麥和粗麥沒有被擊打，因為還沒有長成。）

en.text: Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread out his hands to the LORD; and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured on the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西离了法老出城，向耶和华举手祷告；雷和雹就止住，雨也不再浇在地上了。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西離了法老出城，向耶和華舉手禱告；雷和雹就止住，雨也不再澆在地上了。

en.text: When Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders had ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.

zhSimplified.text: 法老见雨和雹与雷止住，就越发犯罪；他和他的臣仆都硬着心。

zhTraditional.text: 法老見雨和雹與雷止住，就越發犯罪；他和他的臣僕都硬着心。

en.text: The heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go, just as the LORD had spoken through Moses.

zhSimplified.text: 法老的心刚硬，不容以色列人去，正如耶和华借着摩西所说的。

zhTraditional.text: 法老的心剛硬，不容以色列人去，正如耶和華藉着摩西所說的。
